xinjianxue-skill-rel_choice-global v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "Relationship Trade-off Advisor" skill for XinJianXue.
- Provides relationship analysis focusing on trade-offs, needs, and behavioral patterns, without making decisions for the user.
- Requires user confirmation before analysis and strictly enforces subject consent.
- Onboarding flow includes AI license application and secure binding via user authorization code.
- Detailed API instructions and authentication requirements for secure HTTP interaction.
- Explicit, user-facing scope definition and activation/non-activation cases to ensure compliance and privacy.
